integrity: The stated result is a self-contained mathematical classification with an accompanying finite cross-check. Its same-model review does not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact structural formula covers positive four-run words only.
The fixed-Parikh minimum theorem assumes each letter occurs at least four times.
No claim is made about minima among arbitrary binary words, or about occurrence counts or Parikh-equivalence classes.
Unindexed equivalent work and independent verification remain outstanding.
title: Exact Abelian-square content counts and Parikh minima for four-run binary words
